findings.issue: C1548 positive controls passed a vector-subscripted actual to ASYNCHRONOUS/VOLATILE dummies, which p21 forbids, so the controls were themselves nonconforming
findings.resolution: controls use the strided section a(3:1:-2) and change only the C1548-constrained dummy property

findings.issue: sequence association omitted the array-element actual case
findings.resolution: a = [10,20,30,40,50], actual a(3) to explicit-shape d(3) gives d == [30,40,50] and d(2) = 99 sets a(4); plus a default-character substring-of-element case
